pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Listbox (single and multiple selection, roving focus, type-ahead) when selectable; a plain list (role=list) otherwise. Items carry aria-posinset and aria-setsize because only part of the list is rendered.

aria.value: position and total (-1 while more can be loaded)

keyboard.action: Focus the active item (one tab stop); a plain list focuses its scroll container.
First or last enabled item (scrolls far lists instantly).
Select the focused item (single) or toggle it (multiple).

keyboard.key: Shift + Down / Up / Home / End / Space
keyboard.action: Select the range from the anchor to the focused item.
Select all enabled items, or clear them when all are selected.
Type-ahead to the next item whose text starts with the typed characters.

focus: The focused item is always rendered, even when scrolled far away, so focus is never lost; Home, End, and type-ahead scroll the target into view before focusing it.
notes: Selection is shown by a start-edge bar as well as color (WCAG 1.4.1).
Load progress and failures are announced politely through the status element (WCAG 4.1.3).
knownCaveats: Screen readers count only rendered items when browsing by virtual cursor; aria-setsize gives the real total.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
